answer: Each agent must park a minimum stake on a public mesa of bonded identities before it can attest or earn. The stake stays frozen through a long unbonding window, during which peers may flag cloned behavior and slash the deposit. A nebula of throwaway keys therefore cannot be spun up for free: every extra identity multiplies immobilized capital and lost time. Honest attestors receive slashed funds, so monitoring pays for itself. The vine of lockups and delays is the attacker’s true cost, scaling with the number of sybils rather than with cheap key generation.
